_comment: Will of the Jeskai's second mode: 'Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn.' t_will_no_exile is the same grant WITHOUT the rider -- a permission the card can use again and again for the rest of the turn.

cards.name: Test Will Flashback
cards.oracle_text: Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.

cards.name: Test Will Without Exile
cards.oracle_text: Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard.
